limits: F1 is turn-based only and tries two spot distances.
F2 estimates the inactive set's main hand only: special weapon abilities, the off hand and attack modes are left out (errs low); a 1.2x+1 margin and a two-round hold guard against flip-flop.
F3 prices creatures by CR and measured damage; touch AC, trip, immunity matching and AoE exposure are not modelled before a kind has fought.
F4 searches two distances from the most valuable escape walk only.
